Frontend acceptance criteria verified via Playwright: (1) Match Official sidebar restricted to 'My DA / TA Forms' + 'Tournament Calendar' + 'Coming Soon' — no financial nav domains visible; (2) MO /tournaments only shows allocated tournaments (respected in list; note default 'Live' chip may hide Upcoming allocations — minor UX); (3) Division-secretary sees 'DA Review Inbox' under Operations; /da-review renders da-review-filter-{all,submitted,approved,rejected,draft,paid} chips + da-review-stats + stat-flagged; (4) Squad detail (DIV-IND squad 96329508… on SM Khan Trophy) exposes ALL 7 M37 testids — 4 dropdown selects (squad-official-select-umpire_1/2/scorer/referee) backed by /api/match-officials filtered by role (umpires show 4 options incl. Chandrakant/Umesh/Anil Chaudhary; scorer/referee show only default '— select —' since no seeded records for those roles), plus squad-download-nomination-btn, squad-upload-signed-btn, squad-submit-mpca-btn (submit correctly DISABLED until signed copy uploaded); (5) PapaParse import present at TournamentWorkspacePanels.jsx L3 and used at L112 (Papa.parse). One backend bug found + fixed inline: reject_da_form's _create_notification call used kind='warning' but Notification.kind Literal only allows {'claim_event','sla_breach','info'} — caused 500 on every DA reject. Fixed by changing kind='warning' → kind='info' (severity='warning' preserved). Retested: reject flow now 200 and status flips to Rejected with rejection_reason stored + warning-severity notification created.

rca of the issue: reject_da_form 500: Notification.kind is a Pydantic Literal restricted to 'claim_event'|'sla_breach'|'info'; the reject handler passed kind='warning' (probably auto-completed from severity='warning'). Since Notification is constructed inside _create_notification, validation fails → 500 propagates. Fix is a one-line kind='warning' → kind='info' (severity='warning' preserved so UI can still render warning tint). Recommend either widening the Literal to include 'warning' as an alias, OR adding a pytest that constructs Notification with all four call-site kinds in the codebase.
